system.description:
Favoured weapon: Cestus

Granted power: Your Lay on Hands pool is 4 HP per Paladin level instead of 2. Once/day: Lay on Hands also ends Poisoned at no cost; from 8th, Heaven's Answer's third option at no cost. From 9th, twice a day in all, in either form.

Allegiance: Lawful Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Ilmater in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: take on one other's suffering as your own (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
